resilience.name: label-protocol violation detection with repair re-prompt
resilience.what_it_is: Every LLM reply must start with exactly one protocol label (THINK, TOOL, FINISH, ...). A deterministic check classifies the step as missing_label, multiple_labels, tool_without_calls, <label>_with_tools or unknown_action; an optional host hook validate_terminal can reject a terminal label with its own violation key. On violation the loop emits a retry notice, keeps the model's draft (clipped to 500 chars) as assistant context, appends a violation-specific correction prompt and runs the next iteration. Label parsing is tolerant: wrapped labels with one to three backticks, bare labels followed by a separator, leading whitespace/zero-width chars and a leading <think> prelude are accepted; label mentions inside prose are ignored.
resilience.function_in_system: Sits in run_agentic_loop directly after each run_labeled_step call, before the label is acted on. Catches malformed or contradictory model output (no label, label plus stray tool calls, premature finish) and turns it into feedback for the next turn. Otherwise a malformed reply ends the turn or leaks through as the final answer.
